guidance.summary: Full year PLI likely to be close to Rs. 70 crores plus
guidance.speaker: Vishal Gupta
guidance.quote: For the full year, this year, the PLI is likely to be close to Rs. 70 crores plus for us.

guidance.summary: Expecting about volume growth of close to 20% for Room AC business
guidance.speaker: Pramod Gupta
guidance.quote: On a full year basis, we are expecting about volume growth of close to 20% for the Room AC business.

guidance.summary: Room AC delivered about 2.1 to 2.2 million units this year
guidance.speaker: Pramod Gupta
guidance.quote: And we are hoping to have on a full year basis about close to 2.1 -2.2 million kind of a number for room AC delivered this year versus 1.7 last year.

guidance.summary: Average realization increase close to 15-20% range
guidance.speaker: Pramod Gupta
guidance.quote: It will be surely close to about 15%-20% range.

guidance.speaker: Vishal Gupta
guidance.quote: The average price increase across 3 -4 quarters and what we expect in January quarter, all cumulative will be something around 15%.

guidance.summary: Targeting 1.5 million plus compressors for calendar year 27
guidance.speaker: Vishal Gupta
guidance.quote: And there will be a gradual ramp-up for calendar year 27, we are hoping that we will do something around maybe 1.5 million plus compressors. That is the target that we have set for ourselves, 1.5 million plus.

guidance.summary: Costs increasing in line with volume increases of 20-25%
guidance.speaker: Vishal Gupta
guidance.quote: costs will be increasing more in line with the volume increases, which will be about 20 %-25% on an overall company basis and that is what is our internal target.

guidance.summary: About Rs. 60 crores in PG Technoplast next year
guidance.speaker: Pramod Gupta
guidance.quote: So, we will have about Rs. 60 crores in PG Technoplast next year from that.

guidance.summary: Incentive for FY28 between Rs. 105-Rs. 110 crores
guidance.speaker: Dhruv Jain
guidance.quote: So it is safe to say that your incentive for FY28 would be anywhere between Rs. 105-Rs. 110 crores?

guidance.summary: CAPEX for this year guided for around Rs. 400 crores
guidance.speaker: Vishal Gupta
guidance.quote: So, CAPEX for this year, which we have guided for around Rs. 400 crores, is on track

guidance.summary: FY '28 CAPEX should be around Rs. 150-200 crores
guidance.speaker: Vishal Gupta
guidance.quote: Still, FY '28, we should do around Rs. 150 odd or Rs. 200 odd crores CAPEX.

guidance.summary: About 22% odd volume growth in the first half
guidance.speaker: Pramod Gupta
guidance.quote: About 22% odd is the volume growth.

guidance.qualifier: Room AC volume growth full year
guidance.summary: Volume growth should be 20%-25% for the full year
guidance.speaker: Pramod Gupta
guidance.quote: I am guiding that the volume growth should be 20 %-25%, 20% plus minus 2%-3% for the full year.

guidance.summary: Electronics business target around Rs. 550 to 600 crores
guidance.speaker: Pramod Gupta
guidance.quote: 600 crores. Yes, Rs. 550 is the number which we should target.

guidance.qualifier: volume growth third quarter middle teens
guidance.summary: Middle teens volume growth for third quarter
guidance.speaker: Vishal Gupta
guidance.quote: We see some maybe kind of middle teens volume growth for us in third quarter also

guidance.summary: Compressor target for next year between 1.5-1.8 million
guidance.speaker: Vishal Gupta
guidance.quote: should be anything between 1.5 -1.8 million is what we are targeting for next year

guidance.speaker: Vishal Gupta
guidance.quote: I think FY '28, we are targeting 700k production, not more than that.
